title: PSA blood test
what: This is a regular blood test from a vein. It shows the level of a protein made by the prostate gland.
why: To check the prostate in men, usually after age 45 to 50, for problems passing urine, and for follow-up after treatment.
duration: the blood draw takes 2 to 3 minutes; the result usually comes in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you take medicines for an enlarged prostate. They can lower PSA
If you recently had a prostate massage, a rectal exam, a biopsy, or a catheter
If you have inflammation or a urinary tract infection right now
Your past PSA results. It is important to compare

prepare.title: 2 days before
prepare.text: You are usually advised to avoid ejaculation, long bike rides, and heavy exercise for 2 days. These can raise PSA.

prepare.title: After procedures
prepare.text: If you had a prostate exam, massage, or biopsy, the test is usually done later. The doctor will tell you how long to wait.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast. If you are having other tests at the same time, check with your clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Take your medicines as usual. Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor, who will decide.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied around your upper arm
The skin is wiped with alcohol
Blood is taken from a vein into a tube with a needle
A cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a mosquito bite
after: Keep the cotton pad pressed for 3 to 5 minutes
You can eat and go about your day right away
Discuss the result with your doctor. Normal levels depend on age, and one high result is not yet a diagnosis

faq.q: Does a high PSA mean cancer?
faq.a: Not necessarily. PSA can be raised by inflammation, an enlarged prostate, or sex and cycling the day before. The doctor decides whether to repeat the test or check further.

faq.q: How do I prepare for a PSA test?
faq.a: Usually 2 days without ejaculation, cycling, or heavy exercise. And not right after a prostate exam or massage.

faq.q: At what age should I get a PSA test?
faq.a: Usually after 45 to 50, or earlier if close relatives had prostate cancer. It is best to decide together with your doctor.

reminders.text: PSA test in 2 days. Before the test, you are usually advised to avoid sex, cycling, and heavy exercise.
